messages:
Mira: Heads-up — RC cutover in ~45m (15:00 UTC). Soft freeze at 14:30 UTC. If you need a late merge, reply with PR link + short justification. Keep risk and rollback plan in the msg.
Alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5128 — small version bump + changelog entry, no runtime change. CI green locally. Requesting exception. :pray:
Jonah: That PR touches the YAML that controls canary routing — can we confirm no rollout config drift? If it's only version metadata i'm fine, otherwise need review.
Alex: It's literally package.json and CHANGELOG.md. No routing edits. I ran a quick diff: `git diff main...alex/version-bump -- package.json CHANGELOG.md` — nothing else.
Priya: Docs lint failing on the branch — can we run docs pipeline? I can fix in a follow-up patch, but want to avoid blocking.
Mira: @Priya please post the lint error here and a 1-line fix plan. If it's docs-only, we'll allow a docs-only exception provided it's quick.
Priya: Error snippet: `docs/upgrade.md: line 42: MD013 line length`. Fix is one reflow commit. ETA 15m.
Mira: OK — exception OK for docs-only + changelog. @eng-release-bot please tag "docs-exception" and add to the exception queue.
eng-release-bot: [auto] Tagged PR 5128 as docs-exception; assigned to release triage. Queue position: 3.
Jonah: Quick safety check — Alex, add a `revert-if-failing` comment in the PR template with the rollback command so oncall can revert easily if needed. Example: `git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>` and `gh pr checkout 5128 && git revert HEAD` in case.
Alex: Added the revert instructions in the PR description.
ci-bot: Pipeline started for PR 5128 (run #425). Status: running unit tests -> e2e.
Mira: Also, tagging note: when we cut RC tag (rc-2026.03.15), please ensure the package checksum matches the artifact in the release bucket. If anyone is unfamiliar, ping me and I'll walk through the sha check.
Jonah: Re. rollout: if this was more than metadata I'd ask for a canary window. For docs-only we can skip canary.
Priya: If the docs patch slips past cutoff, I can ship a docs-only hotfix after RC cut — no functional dependency.
Mira: Final: exception granted for PR 5128 (docs + changelog). Conditions: CI green, revert comment present, and docs fix merged within 30m. If CI flakes, we'll revert immediately.
Alex: Thanks — will monitor CI.
ci-bot: Pipeline passed: unit ✅, e2e ✅, docs-linter ✅.
Mira: Cool. Marking as approved. I'll cut RC at 15:00 UTC. Everyone please avoid unrelated merges for next 20m. :lock:
Jonah: One more ask — add a short note to the release channel after tag with the rollback commands and the triggering reason list. Saves time for oncall.
Mira: Will do. Post-cutover plan: if we need to rollback, revert the tag `rc-2026.03.15`, revert merge commit, and redeploy previous artifact. Full rollback checklist in the release playbook.
Alex: PR merged at 15:02 UTC (merge commit 7b9f3c2).
eng-release-bot: [auto] Recorded merge 7b9f3c2 into main; added to release candidate rc-2026.03.15 artifacts.
Priya: Docs patch merged at 15:10 UTC.
Mira: Closing thread — RC cut done. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :tada:
